specialists.title: Meteorologia e previsão numérica
specialists.diagnosis: No causal direct Muçum GEFS point with resolved ANA/SGB clock; same-cell Santa proxy is not a forecast point.

specialists.title: Hidrologia local e comportamento da estação
specialists.diagnosis: Four mechanical candidates exist, but ANA/SACE clock and localized divergences remain unresolved.

specialists.title: Solo, umidade e chuva antecedente
specialists.diagnosis: API and antecedent rain are research features only; no local soil measurement and candidate events need confirmation.

specialists.title: Vale do Taquari e dinâmica de bacia
specialists.diagnosis: Shared storm IDs and upstream comparisons are available, but lags must be validated per event.

specialists.title: ML, calibração e operação/Defesa Civil
specialists.diagnosis: No causal Muçum forecast join or calibrated event-level model is available.

decision.reason: Revisões internas orientam a pesquisa; alerta oficial exige validação da fonte e revisão humana competente.
